actions.description: Create a new collection to group mockups for bulk/collection-based rendering.
actions.name: create-collection

catalog_uuid.description: Catalog UUID to associate the collection with. Omit to use the account's default catalog.

actions.description: Delete a previously-uploaded PSD file, optionally cascading to delete any mockup(s) that were created from it.
actions.name: delete-psd

psd_uuid.description: The UUID of the PSD file to delete. Example: "fc2ed284-57f7-406e-b111-952e622beff3"

delete_related_mockups.description: If true, also delete any mockups created from this PSD.

actions.description: Get full details (including available decoration locations) for one POD product, for use with create-mock-anything's product.decorations.
actions.name: get-mock-anything-product

actions.description: Poll the status of an async MockAnything AI mockup-creation task.
actions.name: get-mock-anything-status

taskId.description: The task ID returned by create-mock-anything. Example: "444e0bee-a1a8-4bfa-a312-5f0eae1602d3"

actions.description: Get a single mockup template by uuid.
actions.name: get-mockup

actions.description: Poll the status of an async MotionMockups video-generation request.
actions.name: get-motion-mockup-status

requestId.description: The MotionMockups request ID to poll. Example: "019fd22e-d00d-7771-b9a6-a4bbb3102ee1"

actions.description: List catalogs (top-level containers that scope mockups/collections; every workspace has at least a Default catalog).
actions.name: list-catalogs

actions.description: List collections (named groupings of mockups, e.g. for bulk/collection rendering) in this account.
actions.name: list-collections

catalog_uuid.description: Catalog UUID to filter collections. Example: "6e228160-a9cc-4407-bfa9-464972545fdd"

include_all_catalogs.description: Whether to include collections from all catalogs.

actions.description: List available AI generation styles for MockAnything, optionally filtered by model.
actions.name: list-mock-anything-styles

model.description: AI model to filter styles by. Example: "nano_banana_pro"

actions.description: List mockup templates (both classic PSD-based and MockAnything AI-generated) in this account.
actions.name: list-mockups

catalog_uuid.description: Catalog UUID to filter mockups. Example: "6e228160-a9cc-4407-bfa9-464972545fdd"

collection_uuid.description: Collection UUID to filter mockups. Example: "f035baed-db43-40d5-b260-cdc02458db93"

actions.description: List available image-to-video AI models with their supported durations, aspect ratios, and credit costs.
actions.name: list-motion-mockup-models

actions.description: Search the built-in print-on-demand (POD) product catalog usable with MockAnything AI generation.
actions.name: search-mock-anything-products

query.description: Search term for the built-in print-on-demand product catalog. Example: "shirt"

actions.description: Upload a Photoshop (.psd) file by URL, optionally creating a usable mockup template from it in the same call.
actions.name: upload-psd

psd_file_url.description: Publicly reachable direct URL to the PSD file. Example: "https://example.com/design.psd"

psd_name.description: Optional display name for the uploaded PSD. Example: "Summer Campaign PSD"

psd_category_id.description: Optional category ID. Defaults to 6 ("Other"). Example: 6

create_after_upload.description: If true, creates a usable mockup template immediately after upload. Defaults to false.

collections.description: Collection UUIDs to assign the new mockup to. Example: ["f035baed-db43-40d5-b260-cdc02458db93"]

catalog_uuid.description: Catalog UUID to place the mockup in. Example: "6e228160-a9cc-4407-bfa9-464972545fdd"

syncs.description: Sync catalogs (top-level containers scoping mockups/collections) in this account.
syncs.name: catalogs

syncs.description: Sync collections (named groupings of mockups) in this account.
syncs.name: collections

syncs.description: Sync mockup templates (both classic PSD-based and MockAnything AI-generated) in this account.
syncs.name: mockups
